items.title: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
items.description: Grain exports from both Russia and Ukraine are falling as both countries attack each other's shipping facilities and ports.

items.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
items.description: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.

items.title: ICE plans to equip agents with gloves that can deliver electric shocks
items.description: The US immigration agency is spending $20m on gloves that deliver a sharp electric shock intended to compel subjects to comply.

items.title: Trump says White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to leave post
items.description: Leavitt will depart from her role to spend time with her young children and family, the president says.

items.title: Woman pulled alive from rubble 36 hours after Colombia quake
items.description: Following a 10-hour rescue operation, emergency workers pulled the 32-year-old from beneath slabs of concrete.

items.title: LA Lakers to be sold in record $12.5bn deal
items.description: The Los Angeles Lakers is to be sold for a reported record $12.5bn - less than a year after Mark Walter took a majority stake in the NBA franchise.

items.title: Thousands of Canadians call for US ambassador's expulsion
items.description: An online petition accusing Pete Hoekstra of diplomatic interference in Canadian domestic affairs has garnered more than 60,000 signatures.

items.title: Members of Trump's cabinet remained on decoy plane, after president's quiet exit
items.description: Trump boarded a different plane in Turkey during a Nato summit for security reasons involving Iran.

items.title: US inflation eases as food and fuel costs cool
items.description: Annual US inflation dipped to 3.4% in July, with food costs slowing and housing keeping prices slightly higher.

items.title: Danube river's low water levels reveal remains of WWII soldiers and motorcycle
items.description: A remarkably well-preserved motorcycle and identification tags were found alongside the bodies.

items.title: Singapore and S Korea pull Trader Joe's seasoning over poppy seeds
items.description: Trader Joe's Everything But the Bagel seasoning contains poppy seeds which are banned in both countries.

items.title: Zhu Rongji, who helped turn China into a trading giant, dies at 97
items.description: The former premier brought China into the WTO and championed reforms that fuelled growth.
